note: L2 — framework-neutral component catalogue for the Flare IM UI Kit. Each component is one contract (props/states/events + core-view data source), realised natively per platform. Grounded in the current @flare-im/vue-ui reference implementation (props/events extracted from source).

contentTypes.note: MessageBubble/MessageContentView dispatch body rendering to a per-content-type view via a registry. Products register new types here.

notes.en: Optimistic: status from the core view, never a network wait. toggle-select exists only on Vue and Flutter (onToggleSelect); iOS and Compose do not offer it yet. forward / multiSelect / recall / locate-message are Vue-only: the native bubble raises onLongPress and the host opens MessageActionSheet, whose onAction dispatches those, rather than exposing a callback per action on the bubble.

notes.en: 60fps virtualised; O(visible); scroll anchoring on append/prepend. toggle-select exists only on Vue and Flutter (onToggleSelect); iOS and Compose do not offer it yet. locate-message is Vue-only (in-workbench jump-to-message); native hosts handle it themselves.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 开关 —— 布尔 v-model,平滑滑块。
summary.en: Switch — boolean v-model with a sliding knob.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 复选框 —— 勾选/半选(indeterminate)+ 标签。
summary.en: Checkbox — checked / indeterminate + label.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 单选组 —— 互斥选项,可横排/竖排,单项可禁用。
summary.en: Radio group — mutually-exclusive options, inline or vertical, per-option disable.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 选择器 —— 自适应:桌面为下拉列表,H5/原生 app 为底部 Sheet;勾选态、单项可禁用、聚焦焦点环。
summary.en: Select — adaptive: dropdown on desktop, bottom sheet on H5 / native app; checked state, per-option disable, focus ring.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

description.zh: 移动端 Sheet 顶部标题(缺省用 placeholder)。
description.en: Sheet header title on mobile (defaults to placeholder).

summary.zh: 多行输入 —— 自动增高、字数统计、⌘/Ctrl+Enter 提交。
summary.en: Multi-line input — auto-grow, character counter, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to submit.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

description.zh: 自动增高上限行数(0=不限)。

summary.zh: 步进器 —— −/+ 数字增减,min/max/step,可只读。
summary.en: Stepper — −/+ numeric increment with min/max/step; can be read-only.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 滑块 —— 范围取值,品牌渐变填充,可选值气泡。
summary.en: Slider — range value with brand-gradient fill and an optional value bubble.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 评分 —— 星级取值,悬停预览,可只读/可清除。
summary.en: Rating — star value with hover preview; read-only / clearable.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 时间选择器 —— 自适应:PC 锚定 popover(时/分列),App/H5 底部 Sheet;v-model 取 "HH:mm"。
summary.en: TimePicker — adaptive: anchored popover (hour/minute columns) on PC, bottom sheet on App/H5; v-model as "HH:mm".

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

description.zh: 移动端 Sheet 顶部标题(缺省用 placeholder)。
description.en: Sheet header title on mobile (defaults to placeholder).

summary.zh: 日期选择器 —— 自适应:PC 锚定 popover(月历),App/H5 底部 Sheet;v-model 取 "YYYY-MM-DD",支持 min/max。
summary.en: DatePicker — adaptive: anchored month-calendar popover on PC, bottom sheet on App/H5; v-model as "YYYY-MM-DD", min/max supported.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

description.zh: 移动端 Sheet 顶部标题(缺省用 placeholder)。
description.en: Sheet header title on mobile (defaults to placeholder).

summary.en: Icon library — a cross-platform set of semantic icon names (search/send/heart/…); each platform maps the same names.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

summary.zh: 全局配置 —— 在根部统一默认控件尺寸/密度,并驱动多语言(locale)与主题(浅色/深色)切换;后代用 useFlareConfig() 读取与切换,它返回 { size, setSize, locale, setLocale, themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode, toggleTheme }。该组件不对外发事件。
summary.en: Global config — unify default control size/density at the root and drive language (locale) + theme (light/dark) switching; descendants read and switch via useFlareConfig(), which returns { size, setSize, locale, setLocale, themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode, toggleTheme }. The component emits no events.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入

description.zh: 初始语言('zh-CN' | 'en-US');后代用 useFlareConfig().setLocale() 切换,自动持久化。
description.en: Initial language ('zh-CN' | 'en-US'); switch via useFlareConfig().setLocale(), persisted automatically.

description.zh: 初始主题('light' | 'dark' | 'system');后代用 useFlareConfig().setThemeMode()/toggleTheme() 切换,自动持久化。
description.en: Initial theme ('light' | 'dark' | 'system'); switch via useFlareConfig().setThemeMode()/toggleTheme(), persisted automatically.

notes.en: Web-only by design: a provide/inject config wrapper (size/density/locale/theme). Native platforms achieve the same globally via SwiftUI @Environment / FlareColors.of(scheme) (iOS) and CompositionLocal / MaterialTheme (Compose), so no portable ConfigProvider component is shipped there.
notes.zh: 按设计仅 web:provide/inject 的全局配置包裹件(size/density/locale/theme)。原生端通过 SwiftUI @Environment / FlareColors.of(scheme)(iOS)与 CompositionLocal / MaterialTheme(Compose)达成同等全局配置,故不提供可移植的 ConfigProvider 组件。

summary.en: Conversation workspace — composes ResponsiveLayout and resolves loading / empty / failure for the list, chat and detail panes in one place, plus a cross-pane banner.
summary.zh: 会话工作区 —— 组合 ResponsiveLayout，在一处统一列表 / 聊天 / 详情三栏的加载、空、失败状态，并提供跨栏全局提示。

dataSource.en: Host-owned pane content and per-pane status; no data ownership, no network, no timers.
dataSource.zh: 三栏内容与每栏状态均由宿主传入；组件不拥有数据、不发请求、无定时器。

description.en: Foreground pane in single mode; forwarded verbatim to ResponsiveLayout (default 'list').
description.zh: 单栏时的前置栏；原样透传给 ResponsiveLayout（默认 list）。

description.en: Whether a detail pane exists (enables 3-column). Native platforms derive it from the detail slot, matching ResponsiveLayout.
description.zh: 是否存在详情栏（启用三栏）。原生端与 ResponsiveLayout 一致，由 detail 槽是否传入推导。

description.en: List column width; forwarded verbatim (default 320 logical units).
description.zh: 列表栏宽，原样透传（默认 320 逻辑单位）。

description.en: Detail column width; forwarded verbatim (default 300 logical units).
description.zh: 详情栏宽，原样透传（默认 300 逻辑单位）。

description.en: Hide the built-in narrow-screen back bar when the host supplies its own; forwarded verbatim.
description.zh: 宿主已有返回栏时隐藏内置窄屏返回栏；原样透传。

description.en: Localized back label; forwarded verbatim. Back order (detail → chat → list) stays in ResponsiveLayout.
description.zh: 本地化返回文案；原样透传。窄屏返回顺序（详情→聊天→列表）仍由 ResponsiveLayout 负责。

description.en: Inbox pane state { status: 'ready'|'loading'|'empty'|'failure', message?, actionLabel? }. Independent of the other panes.
description.zh: 列表栏状态 { status: ready|loading|empty|failure, message?, actionLabel? }，与其它两栏互不影响。

description.en: Timeline pane state; a chat failure never turns an already loaded list into a failure.
description.zh: 聊天栏状态；聊天栏失败不会把已加载好的列表栏也变成失败。

description.en: Detail pane state; same shape and rules as the other two.
description.zh: 详情栏状态；结构与规则同前两栏。

description.en: Cross-pane notice (offline / reconnecting / session expired) rendered above all three panes. Blank or whitespace-only messages render nothing; it can coexist with any pane state.
description.zh: 跨栏全局提示（断网 / 重连 / 会话过期），渲染在三栏之上。message 为空或纯空白则不渲染；可与任意栏内状态并存。

description.en: Default empty title for the list pane (default "暂无会话"); state.message wins when present.
description.zh: 列表栏默认空文案（默认“暂无会话”）；state.message 存在时优先。

description.en: Default empty title for the chat pane (default "选择一个会话开始聊天").
description.zh: 聊天栏默认空文案（默认“选择一个会话开始聊天”）。

description.en: Default empty title for the detail pane (default "暂无详情").
description.zh: 详情栏默认空文案（默认“暂无详情”）。

description.en: Default failure reason for the list pane (default "会话列表加载失败").
description.zh: 列表栏默认失败原因（默认“会话列表加载失败”）。

description.en: Default failure reason for the chat pane (default "消息加载失败").
description.zh: 聊天栏默认失败原因（默认“消息加载失败”）。

description.en: Default failure reason for the detail pane (default "详情加载失败").
description.zh: 详情栏默认失败原因（默认“详情加载失败”）。

description.en: Screen-reader text announced while the list skeleton shows (default "正在加载会话列表").
description.zh: 列表栏骨架的读屏文案（默认“正在加载会话列表”）。

description.en: Screen-reader text announced while the chat skeleton shows (default "正在加载消息").
description.zh: 聊天栏骨架的读屏文案（默认“正在加载消息”）。

description.en: Screen-reader text announced while the detail skeleton shows (default "正在加载详情").
description.zh: 详情栏骨架的读屏文案（默认“正在加载详情”）。

summary.zh: 朋友圈可见性名单 —— 「不让他看我的」/「不看他的」两类规则的成员列表与增删。两类方向相反，同屏时必须视觉可分，否则用户会设反。
summary.en: Moments visibility list — members under hide-from / mute rules, with add and remove. The two directions are opposites; they must read as visually distinct or users will set the wrong one.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入（SDK list_visibility_rules）

description.zh: 规则类型。决定标题与空态文案 —— 两类不可共用一套措辞。
description.en: Rule kind. Drives the title and empty-state copy; the two must not share wording.

summary.zh: 通讯录匹配结果 —— 命中用户列表，按 alreadyFriend 分别显示「添加」或「发消息」。新用户上手的关键一屏。
summary.en: Contact match results — matched users, showing Add or Message per alreadyFriend. The key screen for new-user onboarding.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入（SDK match_contacts）

description.zh: 匹配结果。matchedBy 用于在条目上回显命中的号码，便于用户确认是谁。
description.en: Match results. matchedBy echoes which number matched so the user can tell who it is.

summary.zh: 群公告已读条 —— 未确认时显示确认按钮，已确认后转为「x/y 已读」。计数取自服务端权威值，不由未读名单长度反推（名单是截断的）。
summary.en: Announcement read bar — a confirm button while unread, switching to an x/y read count once confirmed. Counts come from the server; never derive them from the truncated unread list.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入（SDK announcement_read_status）

description.zh: 已读人数（服务端权威计数）。
成员总数（服务端权威计数）。
当前用户是否已确认，决定显示确认按钮还是计数。
description.en: Whether the viewer confirmed; decides button vs count.

description.zh: 是否显示「查看未读」入口（一般仅管理员）。
description.en: Show the view-unread entry (admins only, typically).

summary.zh: 发动态时选「谁可以看」—— 公开/好友/私密三档，加上「部分可见」与「不给谁看」两份互斥名单。设错方向的后果不对称，所以两者文案与配色分开。
summary.en: Audience picker for a new moment — public/friends/private, plus the mutually exclusive include and exclude lists. The two directions are not symmetric in consequence, so copy and accent differ.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入（好友列表 + 当前选择）
dataSource.en: passed in by you (friend list + current selection)

description.zh: 0=无名单 1=部分可见 2=不给谁看。与 visibility 正交。

summary.zh: 附件上传/下载状态：真实进度、暂停、失败恢复与完成打开。
summary.en: Attachment transfer status with measured progress and capability-gated recovery actions.

dataSource.zh: 宿主 SDK 传输状态与能力；组件不发网络请求。
dataSource.en: Host SDK transfer state and capabilities; no network operations in the UI.

description.zh: 本地化状态文本，可含失败原因。

description.en: Measured ratio 0..1; unknown is null. Non-finite values are unknown.
description.zh: 实测比例 0..1；未知用 null，非有限值按未知处理。

description.en: Only supported actions with localized labels; filtered by state.
description.zh: 只传 SDK 支持的操作及本地化标签，组件按状态过滤。

description.en: An action is pending; disable repeated activation.
description.zh: 操作处理中，禁用重复触发。

summary.en: Search field, filters, result snapshot and recovery in one panel.
summary.zh: 组合搜索输入、筛选、结果快照与失败恢复。

dataSource.en: Host-owned search snapshot; UI emits criteria and does not query the network.
dataSource.zh: 宿主搜索快照；UI 只提交条件，不执行网络请求。

description.en: Results with the criteria they belong to.
description.zh: 携带归属条件的结果快照。

description.en: Stable filter IDs and localized labels.
description.zh: 稳定筛选 ID 与本地化标签。

description.en: Optional inclusive epoch-millisecond presets; invalid ranges are disabled. Host owns timezone boundaries.
description.zh: 可选毫秒闭区间预设；无效范围禁用。时区边界由宿主提供。
时间筛选组的可访问名称。

summary.en: Bounded transfer queue with per-task recovery and retry-failed batch action.
summary.zh: 有界传输队列，支持逐项恢复与批量重试失败任务。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: Unique stable IDs and transfer presentation data.
description.zh: 唯一稳定任务 ID 及传输展示数据。
刷新状态，保留已有任务。
面向用户的队列加载错误。
批量重试失败任务文案。

summary.en: CapabilityBoundary scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 可选能力状态与内容隔离，失败时保留基础聊天。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: Web 子组件错误后显式重新挂载标识
description.zh: Web 子组件错误后显式重新挂载标识

summary.en: DangerConfirm scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 危险操作目标、后果、确认与失败恢复。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: Web 模态展示；原生由宿主承载
description.zh: Web 模态展示；原生由宿主承载

description.en: 操作处理中禁止再次确认
description.zh: 操作处理中禁止再次确认

description.en: 失败说明，保留确认界面
description.zh: 失败说明，保留确认界面

summary.en: Connection / session details panel with per-state icon, text and tone, optional transport / endpoint / last-sync facts, collapsible diagnostics and host-dispatched reconnect / reauth / copyDiagnostics actions.
summary.zh: 连接与会话状态详情面板：每个状态同时有图标、文字和语气色，可选传输协议 / 服务地址 / 上次同步，折叠的诊断信息，以及由宿主执行的重连 / 重新登录 / 复制诊断动作。

dataSource.en: Host-owned connection state, formatted facts and capabilities; the view never opens or closes a connection.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供连接状态、已格式化的事实与能力；组件不建立也不关闭连接。

description.zh: 当前连接 / 会话状态。

description.en: Endpoint address; long values are visually truncated but fully readable by screen readers.
description.zh: 服务地址；长地址视觉省略，读屏可完整读出。
宿主已格式化的上次同步时间。

description.en: User-facing reason for the current state.
description.zh: 面向用户的当前状态原因文案。

description.en: Multi-line diagnostics text, collapsed by default under the diagnostics section.
description.zh: 多行诊断文本，折叠在“诊断信息”区，默认收起。

description.en: Host is executing a command; all actions are disabled.
description.zh: 宿主正在执行命令；所有动作禁用。

description.en: Vue only: host binds @reconnect (default false hides the button). Native derives this from onReconnect != null.
description.zh: 仅 Vue：宿主已绑定 @reconnect（默认 false 隐藏按钮）。原生端由 onReconnect 是否为空推导。

description.en: Vue only: host binds @reauth (default false hides the button). Native derives this from onReauth != null.
description.zh: 仅 Vue：宿主已绑定 @reauth（默认 false 隐藏按钮）。原生端由 onReauth 是否为空推导。
已在其他设备登录文案。

description.en: Label for sdkUnready (client not ready yet).

description.zh: 复制诊断信息动作文案。

summary.en: Re-authentication prompt for a broken session (expired / kicked / credential invalid / account disabled) with locked resubmission and retained failure reason.
summary.zh: 会话失效时的重新认证提示（过期 / 被踢 / 凭证失效 / 账号停用），锁定重复提交并保留失败原因。

dataSource.en: Host-owned session state; the host implements login and the container.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供会话状态；登录业务与容器由宿主实现。

description.en: Host-supplied detail, e.g. the kicking device and time.
description.zh: 宿主补充说明，例如被踢设备名与时间。

description.en: Re-authentication in progress; locks every button.
User-facing reason the last attempt failed; kept in the panel.
description.zh: 上一次重新认证失败的面向用户原因，保留在面板中。
显示当前账号，便于用户确认。

description.en: Accessible progress text in the primary button while busy.
description.zh: busy 时主按钮的进度可访问文本。

description.en: Secondary button label (sign out / switch account).
description.zh: 次按钮文案（退出登录 / 切换账号）。

summary.en: Unified explanation panel for a missing / denied system permission; request and openSettings are delegated to the host.
summary.zh: 系统权限缺失 / 被拒时的统一说明面板；申请权限与打开设置交给宿主。

dataSource.en: Host-reported permission kind + state; no platform queries, no side effects.
dataSource.zh: 宿主传入权限种类与状态；不查询平台、无副作用。

description.en: Which permission is being explained; selects the icon and default copy.
description.zh: 说明哪种权限；决定图标与默认文案。

description.en: Host-reported state. request only while undetermined; openSettings only while denied; restricted / unavailable show explanation only.
description.zh: 宿主上报的状态。undetermined 才显示 request；denied 才显示 openSettings；restricted / unavailable 只有说明。

description.en: The feature the permission unlocks (e.g. "发送语音消息"); embedded in the default description.
description.zh: 该权限用于的功能（如“发送语音消息”），嵌入默认说明句。

description.en: Extra host explanation shown under the description.
description.zh: 宿主补充说明，显示在说明下方。

description.en: Host is requesting / navigating; every action is disabled.
description.zh: 宿主申请 / 跳转中；禁用全部动作。

description.en: Inline single-row mode for the strip above a composer (default card / panel mode).
description.zh: 行内紧凑模式，放在输入区上方（默认卡片 / 面板模式）。
标题；按 kind 有默认值。

description.en: Explanation; defaults per kind + state with featureLabel embedded.
description.zh: 说明；按 kind + state 有默认值并嵌入 featureLabel。

description.en: State chip label; defaults per state.
description.zh: 状态标签文案；按 state 有默认值。
申请按钮文案（默认“允许”）。

description.en: Open settings action label (default "前往设置").
description.zh: 打开设置按钮文案（默认“前往设置”）。
关闭按钮文案（默认“知道了”）。

summary.en: Search time-range filter: host-supplied preset chips plus a custom start/end pair built from the shared DatePicker, emitting one inclusive epoch-millisecond FlareSearchTimeRange.
summary.zh: 检索时间范围筛选器：宿主提供的预设区间 chips，加上复用各端 DatePicker 的自定义起止日期，统一输出含端的 epoch 毫秒 FlareSearchTimeRange。

dataSource.en: Host-owned range value and preset options; the component holds no clock and never computes "today" itself.
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有当前范围与预设区间；组件不持有时钟，从不自己计算“今天”。

description.en: Current range (inclusive UTC epoch milliseconds); controlled by the host.
description.zh: 当前时间范围（含端的 UTC epoch 毫秒），由宿主受控持有。

description.en: Preset chips with stable ids; the host computes their bounds so the time zone stays its business.
description.zh: 带稳定 id 的预设 chips；边界由宿主计算，时区归宿主负责。

description.en: Offer the custom start/end area (default true); false leaves presets only.
description.zh: 是否开放自定义起止区（默认 true）；false 时只保留预设。

description.en: Force the custom area open, e.g. when restoring a saved filter.
description.zh: 强制展开自定义区，例如恢复已保存的筛选条件。

description.en: Earliest selectable day "YYYY-MM-DD", passed straight to the DatePicker.
description.zh: 最早可选日期 "YYYY-MM-DD"，直接传给 DatePicker。

description.en: Latest selectable day "YYYY-MM-DD", passed straight to the DatePicker.
description.zh: 最晚可选日期 "YYYY-MM-DD"，直接传给 DatePicker。

description.en: Minutes east of UTC (UTC+8 → 480) used for the date/timestamp conversion; omitted, the viewer's own zone.
description.zh: 日期与时间戳换算所用的时区，UTC 以东的分钟数（UTC+8 → 480）；不传则用查看者所在时区。

description.en: Disables every chip, date picker and button.
description.zh: 禁用全部 chips、日期选择与按钮。

description.en: Host can clear the range (Vue, default true); natives derive it from onClear != null.
description.zh: 宿主能否清除时间范围（Vue，默认 true）；原生端由 onClear 是否传入决定。
筛选器标题与读屏名称。

description.en: Clear label, also used for the per-field reset accessible name.
description.zh: 清除文案，同时用于单端清除按钮的读屏名称。

description.en: Summary text when neither bound is set.
description.zh: 两端都未设置时的摘要文案。

description.en: Hint shown when the start date is after the end date.
description.zh: 起始日期晚于结束日期时的提示文案。

summary.en: MemberPanel scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 成员角色展示及可用管理操作。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: 成员姓名、角色文案与宿主许可操作
description.zh: 成员姓名、角色文案与宿主许可操作

summary.en: Placeholder for an account the host cannot describe — unknown, deactivated, blocked or unreachable — so a row never renders blank or shows a bare user id as its title.
summary.zh: 未知 / 已注销 / 已屏蔽 / 不可联系账号的占位展示，避免列表空白或把裸 user id 当标题。

dataSource.en: Host-owned user id and kind; the component computes icon and tone via unknownUserPresentation() and the diagnostic id line via shortenUserId().
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供 user id 与 kind；组件用 unknownUserPresentation() 计算图标与语气、shortenUserId() 计算诊断位 ID。

description.en: The id the host failed to resolve. Rendered only in the diagnostic slot, middle-elided and forced LTR — never the title.
description.zh: 宿主未能解析的 ID。只在诊断位显示，中间省略并强制 LTR，绝不作为主标题。

description.en: Why the profile is missing; drives the default title, its own icon and the tone.
description.zh: 缺失原因；决定默认主标题、专属图标与语气色。

description.en: row (default) for list rows, card for a detail surface.
description.zh: row（默认）用于列表行，card 用于详情页。

description.en: Host supplement, e.g. where the id came from.
description.zh: 宿主补充说明，例如该 ID 的来源。

description.en: Prefix of the diagnostic id line.
description.zh: 诊断位 ID 前缀文案。

description.en: Longest id rendered before middle-eliding; floored at 8.
description.zh: ID 中间省略前的最大长度，下限 8。

summary.en: Relation action bar for the contact detail page: the host supplies the relation, the component computes which actions exist, in one order, with the danger group trailing.
summary.zh: 联系人详情页底部的关系操作条：宿主给关系状态，组件计算可用动作，四端同一顺序、危险动作独立分组置尾。

dataSource.en: Host-owned relation state and capabilities; the component computes displayable actions via relationActions() and the waiting notice via relationShowsPending().
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供关系状态与能力；组件用 relationActions() 计算可显示动作、relationShowsPending() 判定等待态。

description.en: Relation between the viewer and the contact, decided by the host; the component never mutates it.
description.zh: 宿主判定的双方关系状态；组件绝不自行改写。

props.name: capabilities
props.type: { add?, accept?, reject?, remove?, block?, unblock?, message? }

description.en: Boolean switches the host can honour; absent or false hides the action instead of disabling it.
description.zh: 宿主可承接的能力开关；缺省或 false 直接不显示，而不是显示禁用按钮。

description.en: Set synchronously by the host before dispatching; disables every button and shows progress on the triggered one.
description.zh: 宿主发命令前同步置位；禁用全部按钮，并只在被触发项上显示进度。

description.en: Reason the previous command failed; kept on screen until dismissed, never auto-cleared.
description.zh: 上一次操作失败原因；保留展示直到关闭，不自动清空。
删除好友文案（危险分组）。

description.en: Disabled notice shown for pendingOut in place of an add button.
description.zh: pendingOut 时替代添加按钮的禁用态提示文案。

description.en: Appended to the triggered action's accessible name while busy.
description.zh: busy 时追加到被触发项读屏名称的文案。

description.en: Accessible name of the error dismiss button.
description.zh: 错误关闭按钮的读屏名称。

description.en: Shown when no capability is granted so the bar never renders blank.
description.zh: 无任何能力时显示，避免操作条空白。

summary.en: Group settings panel over the real group permission fields, with per-row busy, per-row failure and read-only rendering when the viewer cannot manage.
summary.zh: 群权限设置面板，覆盖群模型真实权限字段；逐项 busy、逐项失败，无管理权限时渲染只读值行。

dataSource.en: Host-owned group settings, canManage flag, in-flight keys and per-key failure reasons; the component computes rows via groupPermissionRows().
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供群设置、canManage、进行中的键与逐键失败原因；组件用 groupPermissionRows() 计算行。

description.en: The real group permission fields; joinPolicy is 1 = invite only, 2 = approval, 3 = open.
description.zh: 群模型真实权限字段；joinPolicy 1=仅邀请 2=需审批 3=公开。

description.en: Viewer may edit; false renders read-only value rows instead of disabled switches.
description.zh: 可修改；false 渲染只读值行，而不是禁用开关。

description.en: Keys whose command is in flight; only those rows lock.
description.zh: 正在提交的键；仅这些行锁定。

description.en: Per-key failure reason, kept on the row with retry until the host dismisses it.
description.zh: 逐键失败原因，保留在行上并可重试，直到宿主清除。

description.en: Explains why the panel is read-only.
Shown when joinPolicy is outside 1/2/3 — the value is passed through, never guessed.
description.zh: joinPolicy 不在 1/2/3 时显示；数值原样保留，不猜测。
仅管理员可 @所有人 标题。
仅管理员可 @所有人 说明。

description.en: Read-only value for an enabled flag.
Read-only value for a disabled flag.
Retry the failed row's last intent.

summary.en: Per-member management menu (role, mute, remove, transfer ownership) with rank rules before capabilities and a trailing danger group.
summary.zh: 单个群成员的管理菜单（角色、禁言、移出、转让群主），身份等级先于能力开关，危险动作单独分组置底。

dataSource.en: Host-owned member snapshot, viewer role, capabilities and mute durations; the component computes displayable actions via memberRoleActions().
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供成员快照、自己的角色、能力与禁言时长；组件用 memberRoleActions() 计算可显示动作。

description.en: Target member; id must be stable and is echoed in the action payload.
description.zh: 目标成员；id 必须稳定，并原样带回 action 事件。

description.en: The viewer's own role — rank rules apply before capabilities and cannot be overridden by them.
description.zh: 查看者自己的角色；身份等级规则先于能力开关，且不可被能力开关绕过。

props.name: capabilities
props.type: { promote?, demote?, mute?, unmute?, remove?, transferOwner? }

description.en: Boolean switches the host can honour; absent or false hides the action.
description.zh: 宿主可承接的能力开关；缺省或 false 不显示该动作。

description.en: Host-supplied mute durations; empty hides mute entirely — the kit ships none.
description.zh: 宿主提供的禁言时长；为空则完全不显示 mute，组件不内置时长。

description.en: Set synchronously by the host before dispatching; disables every row and duration.
description.zh: 宿主发命令前同步置位；禁用全部行与时长按钮。

description.en: Muted state label in the header.
Mute label; expands the host's durations.
description.zh: 禁言文案；展开宿主时长列表。
解除禁言文案；直接派发。
移出群聊文案（危险分组）。
转让群主文案（危险分组）。

description.en: Heading of the trailing danger group.
Shown when the viewer has no management rights, so the menu never opens blank.
description.zh: 无管理权限时显示，避免菜单空白。

description.en: Shown when the target is the owner — protected by rank, not by a missing capability.
description.zh: 目标是群主时显示；这是身份等级保护，不是能力缺失。

summary.en: DeviceSessions scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 登录设备与逐项撤销会话。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

summary.en: NotificationPreferences scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 通知权限与受控偏好设置。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: 受控值、可用状态与 busy
description.zh: 受控值、可用状态与 busy

description.en: 宿主权限恢复入口文案
description.zh: 宿主权限恢复入口文案

summary.en: Storage management panel over a host-measured usage snapshot, with per-category busy, per-category clear failure, and unknown sizes reported as unknown instead of 0 B.
summary.zh: 存储空间管理面板，展示宿主测量的占用快照；逐分类 busy、逐分类清理失败，大小未知显示「未知」而不是 0 B。

dataSource.en: Host-measured per-category usage, optional host total and device free space, plus in-flight and failure state per category; the component computes totals, shares and clearability via storageTotals()/storageShare()/canClearStorage() and formats sizes via formatBytes().
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供分类占用、可选总占用与设备可用空间，以及逐分类的进行中与失败状态；组件用 storageTotals()/storageShare()/canClearStorage() 计算总计、占比与可清理性，用 formatBytes() 格式化大小。

description.en: Per-category snapshot { id, label, bytes?, fileCount?, clearable?, busy?, error? }; ids must be stable and are echoed in every event.
description.zh: 分类快照 { id, label, bytes?, fileCount?, clearable?, busy?, error? }；id 必须稳定，所有事件都用它回指。

description.en: Host-measured overall footprint; omitted, the component sums the known categories and marks the sum as a floor.
description.zh: 宿主给的总占用；缺省时组件对已知分类求和，并标注这是下限。

description.en: Free space left on the device; shown only when the host knows it.
description.zh: 设备可用空间；宿主知道时才展示。

description.en: First measurement in flight — skeleton plus a spoken status, never a fake empty list; already-known categories stay visible.
description.zh: 首次统计中——骨架 + 可访问文案，不伪装成空列表；已有分类保持可见。

description.en: Whole-snapshot measurement failure; the known categories stay on screen and the banner offers re-measure.
description.zh: 整体统计失败；已统计出的分类继续可见，错误区提供重新统计。

description.en: BCP-47 tag threaded through to formatBytes; digits and unit suffixes are the same in every locale by design.
description.zh: 透传给 formatBytes 的语言标签；数字与单位后缀在所有语言下一致。

description.en: Shown for a size the host has not measured — never rendered as 0 B.
description.zh: 宿主尚未统计出的大小显示此文案，绝不写成 0 B。

description.en: Prefix for a total the component summed itself while some category is still unknown.
description.zh: 组件自行求和且存在未知分类时，总计前面的「至少」。

description.en: Label in front of the total.
Label in front of the device free space.
description.zh: 设备可用空间前缀文案。
重试该分类失败的清理。

description.en: Dismiss one category's failure, or the whole-snapshot one.
description.zh: 忽略某分类的失败原因，或整体统计错误。

description.en: Accessible label for the first measurement.
description.zh: 首次统计中的可访问文案。

description.en: Explains why there is nothing to show when the host has no categories.
description.zh: 宿主没有任何分类时说明原因。

description.en: File-count template; `{count}` is replaced with the category's file count.
description.zh: 文件数模板；`{count}` 会被该分类的文件数替换。

summary.en: MediaCenter scene composition with explicit host-owned state.
summary.zh: 媒体目录、可用预览与附件任务组合。

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供任务快照、权限及能力。

description.en: 媒体类型、可用状态与操作
description.zh: 媒体类型、可用状态与操作

summary.en: Controlled RTC device selection with permission and busy states.
summary.zh: 受控 RTC 设备选择，包含权限与处理中状态。

dataSource.en: Host RTC device inventory and confirmed selection.
dataSource.zh: 宿主 RTC 枚举结果和已确认的设备选择。

description.en: Microphone, speaker and camera groups with stable device IDs.
description.zh: 麦克风、扬声器和摄像头分组，设备 ID 稳定。
设备选择能力是否可用。

notes.en: No automatic selection or permission request. Host owns RTC, race handling and screen sharing.
notes.zh: 不自动选择或申请权限；RTC、异步竞态和屏幕共享由宿主负责。

summary.en: In-call screen-share control and status panel with per-state icon, text and tone, indeterminate progress while requesting, and host-dispatched start / stop / cancel intents.
summary.zh: 通话中的屏幕共享控制与状态面板：每个状态同时有图标、文字和语气色，请求中显示不确定进度，开始 / 停止 / 取消由宿主执行。

dataSource.en: Host- / RTC-plugin-owned share state and labels; the view never captures a screen, enumerates sources or encodes video.
dataSource.zh: 宿主 / RTC 插件提供共享状态与文案；组件不采集屏幕、不枚举共享源、不编码。

description.en: idle = may start; requesting = waiting for the system / plugin; sharing = the local user is sharing; viewing = watching someone else; unavailable = the runtime or plugin has no screen-share capability.
description.zh: idle=可以发起；requesting=已请求、等待系统 / 插件回应；sharing=自己正在共享；viewing=正在观看别人共享；unavailable=运行环境或插件不支持。

description.en: What is being shared, e.g. "整个屏幕" / "Chrome 窗口"; shown only while sharing.
description.zh: 正在共享的内容，如“整个屏幕”“Chrome 窗口”；仅 sharing 时显示。

description.en: Who is sharing; shown only while viewing.
description.zh: 谁在共享；仅 viewing 时显示。

description.en: Extra host explanation, e.g. a bitrate-limited notice or why sharing is unavailable.
description.zh: 宿主补充说明，如码率受限提示或不支持的原因。

description.en: Host is executing a command; every action is disabled but keeps its place.
description.zh: 宿主正在执行命令；全部动作禁用但保留按钮位置。

description.en: Vue only: host binds @start (default false hides the button). Native derives this from onStart != null.
description.zh: 仅 Vue：宿主已绑定 @start（默认 false 隐藏按钮）。原生端由 onStart 是否为空推导。

description.en: Vue only: host binds @stop (default false hides the button). Native derives this from onStop != null.
description.zh: 仅 Vue：宿主已绑定 @stop（默认 false 隐藏按钮）。原生端由 onStop 是否为空推导。

description.en: Vue only: host binds @cancel (default false hides the button). Native derives this from onCancel != null.
description.zh: 仅 Vue：宿主已绑定 @cancel（默认 false 隐藏按钮）。原生端由 onCancel 是否为空推导。
面板标题（默认“屏幕共享”）。
idle 状态文案（默认“未在共享”）。

description.en: Label for requesting; also the accessible name of the progress indicator.
description.zh: requesting 状态文案，同时作为进度条的可访问名称。

description.en: Label for sharing (default "正在共享屏幕").
description.zh: sharing 状态文案（默认“正在共享屏幕”）。

description.en: Label for viewing (default "正在观看共享").
description.zh: viewing 状态文案（默认“正在观看共享”）。

description.en: Label for unavailable (default "当前环境不支持屏幕共享").
description.zh: unavailable 状态文案（默认“当前环境不支持屏幕共享”）。

description.en: Row label for sourceLabel (default "共享内容").
description.zh: 共享内容行标签（默认“共享内容”）。
共享者行标签（默认“共享者”）。
开始共享动作文案（默认“共享屏幕”）。
停止共享动作文案（默认“停止共享”）。
取消请求动作文案（默认“取消请求”）。
